content.comment_body: Hello, I am unable to connect using the [product_name] mobile app, even though I have the correct settings and my Android phone version is 6.0. If anyone can assist, thanks in advance.

Product number - [article_no] Firmware/Software version - [version_no] Android version 6.0. The hostname I created works perfectly with the [product_name] web server and the other customized site option (LWE). The [product_name] app version I use is [version_no].
What does this information indicate? Has your issue been resolved or does it persist?
The issue remains unresolved; I have simply provided additional information.
Have you enabled access for [product_name] smartphone applications under Tools > Transfer > Access control?

Thank you for offering help, but I have already completed these steps. As mentioned earlier, I am able to access the [product_name] using a browser with NO-IP (hostname). However, when I attempt to enable the [product_name] app, even though the settings appear to transfer to the PLC, trying to connect results in the following message: Connection Failed! Error transferring [url] server replied: Not Found.
Hello, I am experiencing the same issue. Is there any solution available?

In the [product_name] app, you should create a new connection with the hardware checkbox [article_no]. Enter the hostname without HTTP and omit the port number. Set the port number to forward to 8080 of [product_name] in the port field. Enter the login password at the end and save. If the connection succeeds, the small square box will light up green.

analysis.insight_summary: Multiple users are encountering difficulties connecting to [product_name] devices via the mobile app on Android, despite confirming the same network parameters allow successful web server access. Main challenges include repeated connection failures and unclear error messages, which lead to user frustration and lack of actionable steps for troubleshooting within the app interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable and straightforward app-based connectivity to [product_name] devices when web access works, along with clear error messages and instructions that help resolve connection issues quickly.
